condition_types.EVENT: Fires at a specific moment — tight, precise
condition_types.STATE: Can be true for hours — use only as filter, never alone

_legend.rule: Every set must have at least 1 EVENT condition as anchor

buy_sets.name: TEST_DEBUG_STRATEGY
buy_sets.notes: Always triggers true. Used ONLY for debugging/testing the API pipeline.

buy_sets.name: BUY_PERFECT_TREND_PULLBACK
buy_sets.notes: Strict trend continuation. Buys the dip only when intraday trend is up (above VWAP) AND short-term trend is up (EMA9>EMA21) AND RSI is recovering AND a bullish candle confirms the bottom.

_conditions_audit.price_above_vwap: STATE — Intraday macro trend must be bullish
_conditions_audit.ema_trending_up: STATE — Short-term trend must be bullish

buy_sets.name: BUY_GOLDEN_CROSSOVER_SURGE
buy_sets.notes: Very strict crossover. EMA 9/21 cross must be accompanied by a volume spike AND must happen above VWAP. Blocks fake crossovers in downtrends.

_conditions_audit.price_above_vwap: STATE — Intraday macro trend must be bullish

buy_sets.name: BUY_POWER_BREAKOUT
buy_sets.notes: High probability breakout. Price breaks recent high with volume + MACD is positive + RSI isn't overbought + Price is above VWAP + OBV is trending up.

_conditions_audit.volume_breakout: EVENT — Breakout with volume and above SMA20

buy_sets.name: BUY_OVERSOLD_REVERSAL_WITH_VOLUME
buy_sets.notes: Bottom fishing, but made extremely strict by requiring a volume spike along with RSI < 35, MACD cross, and bullish candle. Avoids catching falling knives.

_conditions_audit.volume_spike: EVENT — Confirms smart money buying the dip

buy_sets.name: BUY_VWAP_RECLAIM_POWER
buy_sets.notes: Price reclaims VWAP, but strictly requires volume spike and a bullish reversal candle to confirm it's not a fakeout.

_conditions_audit.volume_spike: EVENT — Must have volume to break VWAP resistance

buy_sets.name: BUY_BOLLINGER_SQUEEZE_REVERSAL
buy_sets.notes: Reversal from extreme Bollinger Band panic. Requires touching lower band, a bullish reversal candle, and RSI recovering to confirm momentum shift.

_conditions_audit.bollinger_band_bounce: EVENT — Touched bottom band and bounced

buy_sets.name: BUY_MORNING_STAR_DIP
buy_sets.notes: Classic Morning Star 3-candle reversal pattern on a pullback, confirmed by RSI recovering.

buy_sets.name: BUY_THREE_SOLDIERS_MOMENTUM
buy_sets.notes: Three White Soldiers pattern showing pure buying pressure, confirmed by OBV trending up.

buy_sets.name: BUY_RSI_35_SUPPORT_BOUNCE
buy_sets.notes: Custom strategy: RSI crosses 35 from below, confirmed by two back-to-back green candles acting as support.

_conditions_audit.rsi_crosses_35_up: EVENT — RSI breaks out of extreme oversold
_conditions_audit.two_green_candles: EVENT — Two consecutive green candles acting as support

sell_sets.name: SELL_EMA_MOMENTUM_LOSS
sell_sets.notes: Early exit. Price breaks below EMA20 (EVENT) and RSI confirms weakening momentum (SEMI). Fast, reliable, no candle dependency.

_conditions_audit.ema20_breakdown: EVENT — anchor (price crossed below EMA20 in lookback window)

sell_sets.name: SELL_VWAP_RSI_REVERSAL
sell_sets.notes: Price loses VWAP + RSI weakening + EMA breakdown. Added ema20_breakdown as EVENT anchor. Without it, price_below_vwap (STATE) + rsi_weakening (SEMI) would fire continuously in any afternoon downtrend.

sell_sets.name: SELL_MACD_EMA_WEAKNESS
sell_sets.notes: MACD bearish cross aligned with EMA20 breakdown. Both are EVENT conditions — this is the tightest, most reliable sell set. High conviction exit.

sell_sets.name: SELL_EMA_CROSS_WEAKNESS
sell_sets.notes: EMA9 below EMA21 (STATE) + price below VWAP (STATE) + MACD bearish cross (EVENT). Critical fix: original had 2 pure STATE conditions — would fire every 5 seconds in a downtrend. macd_bearish_cross added as mandatory EVENT anchor.

sell_sets.name: SELL_BREAKDOWN_CONFIRMED
sell_sets.notes: Support broken AND EMA confirms breakdown. Both are EVENT conditions. Reliable structural exit — not noise, not a fake dip.

sell_sets.name: SELL_RSI_BEARISH_REVERSAL
sell_sets.notes: Overbought RSI (> 70) with a bearish candle pattern. Momentum exhaustion at the top. bearish_pattern is the EVENT anchor.

_conditions_audit.bearish_pattern: EVENT — anchor (bearish engulfing or shooting star)
